name: Blood Demon
tactics: The scent of blood brings these fiends to a frothing boil. Hunger and rage drive a blood demon, and it attacks bloodied enemies in preference to other targets, moving twice rather than attacking in order to run down a badly injured foe.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Blood Feast
traits.details: The blood demon gains 1 action point whenever one of its attacks bloodies an enemy. The demon can have only 1 action point at a time.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.details: The blood demon gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls for each bloodied enemy within 10 squares of it (maximum +5).

traits.name: Ooze
traits.details: While squeezing, the blood demon moves at full speed rather than half speed, it doesn’t take the -5 penalty to attack rolls, and it doesn’t grant combat advantage for squeezing.

hit.description: damage, and the demon pulls the target 2 squares.

powers.name: Variable Resistance
powers.trigger: The demon takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: The demon gains resist 15 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until it uses variable resistance again.
